title: RTL triage before review
description: Walk an RTL change through the reference extension's triage skill, then hand the result to a reviewer. Use before a Verilog/SystemVerilog change is reviewed.
whenToUse: Use when a Verilog/SystemVerilog change needs a first pass before review.

steps.title: Collect the change
steps.detail: Read the diff and list the touched files.
steps.output: The list of touched files with a one-line purpose each.

steps.title: Apply the triage skill
steps.detail: Follow the `rtl-triage` skill: classify functional vs editorial, then name the contract each functional change can break.
steps.output: A ranked list of risks with file and line.

steps.title: Ask the reference MCP server
steps.detail: Call the extension's own MCP tool `mcp__example__describe_extension` to confirm which kinds this extension actually contributes in this boot.
steps.output: The extension id, root and contributed kinds as the running host sees them.
